name: Openness
definition: Interest in new ideas, imagination and unfamiliar experiences.
lower: More drawn to familiar methods, concrete ideas and established routines.
higher: More drawn to imagination, exploration and unfamiliar perspectives.

facets.name: Imagination
facets.definition: Use of fantasy, daydreaming and mental imagery.
facets.higher: Enjoy imagining possibilities and alternatives.

facets.name: Artistic Interests
facets.definition: Interest in art, beauty and aesthetic experiences.
facets.higher: More moved by art and beauty.

facets.name: Emotional Sensitivity
facets.definition: Attention to feelings and emotional experiences.
facets.higher: Notice and explore feelings more closely.

facets.name: Variety Seeking
facets.definition: Preference for variety and unfamiliar experiences.
facets.higher: Seek variety and unfamiliar experiences.

facets.name: Intellectual Curiosity
facets.definition: Interest in abstract ideas and complex questions.
facets.higher: Enjoy complex or abstract questions.

facets.name: Liberalism
facets.definition: Preference for liberal social and political views.
facets.lower: Prefer conservative social and political views.
facets.higher: Prefer liberal social and political views.

name: Conscientiousness
definition: Organisation, responsibility and persistence when working towards goals.
lower: More spontaneous and flexible about plans, routines and commitments.
higher: More deliberate, structured and persistent in pursuing commitments.

facets.name: Perceived Competence
facets.definition: Confidence in handling tasks and meeting demands.
facets.higher: More confident in personal effectiveness.

facets.name: Orderliness
facets.definition: Preference for organisation, structure and tidiness.
facets.higher: Prefer clear systems and orderly routines.

facets.name: Dependability
facets.definition: Sense of obligation and commitment.
facets.higher: Feel strongly bound by commitments.

facets.name: Achievement Striving
facets.definition: Drive to pursue goals and demanding standards.
facets.lower: More content with a manageable pace.
facets.higher: Work hard towards ambitious goals.

facets.name: Self-Discipline
facets.definition: Persistence with tasks despite boredom or distraction.
facets.lower: More easily put off unappealing tasks.
facets.higher: Keep going despite boredom or distraction.

facets.name: Deliberation
facets.definition: Deliberation before decisions and action.
facets.higher: Weigh consequences before deciding.

name: Extraversion
definition: Social engagement, self-expression and preference for stimulation.
lower: More reserved, comfortable with solitude and drawn to a quieter pace.
higher: More outgoing, expressive and energised by social activity.

facets.name: Friendliness
facets.definition: Openness in expressing warmth and approaching others.
facets.lower: Take longer to warm to people.
facets.higher: Readily show warmth and approach others.

facets.name: Sociability
facets.definition: Preference for company and social gatherings.
facets.higher: Enjoy frequent company and larger groups.

facets.name: Assertiveness
facets.definition: Readiness to speak up, influence and lead.
facets.higher: Readily speak up and take charge.

facets.name: Activity Level
facets.definition: Preferred pace and amount of activity.
facets.higher: Like to stay busy and active.

facets.name: Excitement-Seeking
facets.definition: Appetite for intense and stimulating experiences.
facets.higher: Seek excitement and strong stimulation.

facets.name: Cheerfulness
facets.definition: Experience and expression of positive emotion.
facets.higher: Experience enjoyment and enthusiasm more often.

name: Agreeableness
definition: Trust, consideration and cooperation in relationships with others.
lower: More questioning, competitive and willing to prioritise personal interests.
higher: More trusting, accommodating and attentive to other people's needs.

facets.name: Trust
facets.definition: Expectation that other people have good intentions.
facets.higher: More inclined to give others the benefit of doubt.

facets.name: Fairness
facets.definition: Reluctance to pursue personal gain at another person's expense.
facets.lower: Readier to pursue gain at others' expense.
facets.higher: More reluctant to take advantage of others.

facets.name: Helpfulness
facets.definition: Inclination to help and respond to other people’s needs.
facets.lower: Less inclined to become involved in others’ needs.
facets.higher: More readily offer help and support.

facets.name: Cooperation
facets.definition: Willingness to compromise when interests conflict.
facets.lower: More willing to challenge and compete.
facets.higher: Prefer compromise and reducing conflict.

facets.name: Modesty
facets.definition: Tendency to downplay personal achievements.
facets.higher: Prefer to downplay personal achievements.

facets.name: Compassion
facets.definition: Emotional concern for other people’s difficulties.
facets.lower: Give more weight to detached judgement.
facets.higher: More readily feel concern for others.

name: Emotional Reactivity
definition: Sensitivity to stress and the experience of difficult emotions.
lower: More even emotional responses and less frequent distress under pressure.
higher: More frequent or intense difficult emotions and stress reactions.

facets.name: Anxiety
facets.definition: Anticipation of threat and experience of worry.
facets.lower: Less prone to worry and tension.
facets.higher: More alert to threat and uncertainty.

facets.name: Irritability
facets.definition: Readiness to experience irritation and anger.
facets.higher: More readily frustrated or angered.

facets.name: Discouragement
facets.definition: Tendency to experience sadness and discouragement.
facets.higher: More prone to sadness or discouragement.

facets.name: Social Confidence
facets.definition: Comfort and self-assurance in social situations.
facets.higher: Less concerned about social scrutiny.

facets.name: Indulgence
facets.definition: Difficulty resisting urges and temptations.
facets.lower: Find it easier to resist temptation.
facets.higher: Find strong urges harder to resist.

facets.name: Stress Tolerance
facets.definition: Capacity to remain composed under pressure.
facets.higher: More composed when demands build.
